name: Jump Buffer
description: Simple cube jump buffer: a press made just before landing fires the moment you land. Settings button on the main menu.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the buffer on or off.

buffer-ms.name: Buffer window (ms)
buffer-ms.description: How long before landing a press is remembered. 17 ms is about 1 frame at 60 FPS.

practice-only.name: Practice mode only
practice-only.description: ON: only buffer in practice mode. OFF: buffer in every run.
